effective_scope: Latest user instruction avoid OOM for all continuing local research/support. Applies to future launches and stage boundaries; preserve healthy admitted workers.
formula: parent memory.current + max(0, active worker reservation - that worker's actual cgroup memory.current) + new support bound <=17GB; a fresh GPU admission uses current parent + full new worker reserve + simultaneous support bound <=17GB
enforcement: Controller and delegated owners use this stronger prelaunch condition alongside existing durable18GB guard. No source/cgroup-cap change or new controller.
size_safety: Real-format bounded headers, shape*dtype plus transformations/masks/libraries/transients, physical disk staging, immutable hardlinks, memmaps/streaming. No unbounded read_bytes on model/data, no large tmpfs, no duplicate full stacks merely to inspect metadata.

measured_support_case.reason: Legitimate measured non-reclaimable working arrays need margin; reuse successful result, not retry or relax malformed-parser failure.

failure_action: Preserve exact first failure and cgroup/PID evidence, diagnose bounded successor, never blind retry/refit valid completed science or kill a healthy fit for support work.
